description: خوراکی خوشمزه با ترکیب گوشت و ماهی؛ سرشار از پروتئین و به دلیل فرم خاصش مؤثر در کاهش پلاک دندانی.
bodyDescription: This is a tasty treat for your four-legged friend who loves the combination of meat and fish. Delicious snack with high protein content and, due to its shape, also conducive against dental plaque. Ideal as a snack for all adult dogs.
